Chapter 677 - 677 Repairing The Door!

Chapter 677 - 677 Repairing the Door!

677 Repairing the Door!

Lin Fan did not attack right away. Instead, he started to observe them carefully, as though he was trying to find some sort of pattern from these cracks.

Xia Xue could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, how did these cracks come about? Are they easy to repair?”

Lin Fan said, “The first possibility is that the world might have been attacked. If that’s the case, it’ll be easier to fix the cracks.

“The second possibility is that the world’s lifespan is coming to an end. If that’s the case, it’ll be more troublesome.”

“Then how should we repair it?” Xia Bing asked.

“The world is weaved by the net of laws, and so is the Wall of the World. As long as you find the thread of the net, then inject the power of laws along the thread, you can continue weaving and repairing it,” Lin Fan said.

As he spoke, his eyes flashed with golden light. He quickly locked onto the crack on the left.

Then, he waved his hand.

“Whoosh!”

A long line of Rule Force wriggled out. Lin Fan seized the time to pour in the power of Rule Force and weaved it continuously.

One, two, three… Many of the cracks were being stitched up and repaired.

The entire Wall of the World was gradually developing in a rounded direction.

Lin Fan’s forehead was covered in a thin layer of sweat.

Obviously, repairing the cracks was also quite difficult for him.

After an unknown period of time, the last crack was finally repaired.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

However, before he could rejoice, another crack spread out.

Lin Fan’s brows raised. “What?”

Even if the world was old, it was impossible for cracks to appear immediately after it was repaired.

Lin Fan’s eyes were like two suns, dazzling and eye-catching as he stared at the crack.

There seemed to be a deep passage in the crack.

At the end of the passage was an ancient door covered in cracks. On the door was a traditional Hua character that said ‘Qian’.

Lin Fan was shocked. “What is this?”

He released a wisp of spiritual power and came to the front of the ancient door. He felt the heavy pressure spreading from it and did not dare to touch it for a moment.

Lin Fan pondered for a moment before bringing Xia Xue and Xia Bing back into the void.

At this moment, the red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows had already recovered some of their strength.

When they saw Lin Fan, they quickly asked.

“How is it? Did you successfully repair the cracks in the Wall of the World?”

“How’s the situation?”

They had been working hard for the rift for tens of thousands of years, and now, they had lost most of their power. They were extremely looking forward to the result of success.

Lin Fan said, “The cracks have been repaired.”

As soon as he said this, all the shadows let out a hearty laugh.

“Good!”

“That’s great!”

“Finally, we succeeded!”

This had been their wish for many years, and it had finally been fulfilled.

Their efforts and sacrifices were not in vain!

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “Don’t be happy too early.”

“I just finished repairing the cracks, but another crack immediately appeared. In addition, I saw an ancient door that was about to shatter in the crack.”

The shadows immediately started discussing.

“How did this happen?”

“Why did the crack suddenly appear again after the repairs?”

“Lin Fan, did you not repair the cracks properly?”

…

The joy from before immediately turned into endless sadness.

This was simply throwing them from the sky to the ground. It was no wonder that they would be like this.

At this moment, the red shadow hurriedly asked, “Is there a word on the door? Does it say ‘Qian’?”

This time, it was Lin Fan’s turn to be shocked.

“How did you know?”

“It’s true,” muttered the red shadow. “The legend is true.”

“What legend?” Lin Fan asked.

The other shadows also cast questioning looks at him.

“Red, what do you know?”

“Hurry up and tell us.”

“Why is there a door in the crack?”

…

“Bring me to the door first,” said the red shadow.”

Lin Fan nodded his head.

The next moment, Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Red, Green, Blue, Gray, Purple, and Black appeared in front of the door.

“This… What a powerful pressure.”

“When did this door appear in the crack?”

“What is it that left so many cracks on this door?”

…

As everyone discussed, their gazes fell on the red shadow.

The red shadow did not speak. He just stared at the door.

After a while, he said, “As expected, the legend is true.

“It’s rumored that there’s a World Lord in our world. He’s called Qian Sheng, and he has endless power.

“When Qian Sheng came to this world, it was still barren. Therefore, he used his supreme power to create mountains, rivers, animals, and plants… After countless years of reproduction, this world came to be what it’s like now.

“Later on, the world was destroyed by an unknown force, and a huge hole appeared.

“In order to prevent the world from shattering, he refined the Qian door to repair it, allowing the world to regain its peace.

“In the past, I thought that this was just a legend…

“If he’s so powerful, why are there so many cracks on the door now?” the blue shadow asked. “Also, where did he go?”

“I don’t know either.” The red shadow shook its head.

At this moment, the entire door suddenly emitted a loud sound. The door that was already covered in cracks immediately showed more cracks. It was one step closer to being completely shattered.

“What?”

Everyone exclaimed in unison.

“Something is hitting the door!”

“What should we do now?”

“I’m afraid the door won’t be able to hold on for long.”

Their tone was extremely solemn.

They all knew that once the door was broken, a huge hole would appear in the Wall of the World in a short period of time.

Moreover, the existence that was crashing into the door was probably extremely powerful.

It was very likely that they were enemies and not friends!

Without a doubt, this was a huge crisis.

Lin Fan said, “Let’s go back and think of a way.”

Everyone looked deeply at the door and said, “Alright.”

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Xia Bing returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa in Jiangbei.

When Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, Lin Xiaoyao, Hu Tian, Song Jiaxin, and the others saw them, they were all overjoyed.

“Lin Fan, you guys are back!”

“Are you hungry? Do you want to eat something?”

“Are you thirsty?”

Everyone spoke up one after another, asking about their well-being. It was very warm.

Ten days passed in a flash.

These few days, Lin Fan had been spending time with his family.

He looked at his family’s happy faces and felt happy but also a little heavy.

That was because he thought of the door and the crack…

Once the door was broken and the enemy appeared, this happiness might turn into nothingness.

He did not want that to happen.

Lin Fan started to think about how to stop this from happening.

The only way was to become stronger.

Only when one was strong enough could one not fear the enemy. He could be like the legendary Qian Sheng who could stop the Wall of the World from breaking.
